name: t42-theta-directory
description: A very simple LDAP management and SSO system

scripts.test:docker: docker compose -f ../docker-compose.test.yml down -v && docker compose -f ../docker-compose.test.yml up --build --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from test-runner && docker compose -f ../docker-compose.test.yml down -v
scripts.test:e2e: docker compose -f ../docker-compose.e2e.yml down -v && docker compose -f ../docker-compose.e2e.yml up --build --abort-on-container-exit && docker compose -f ../docker-compose.e2e.yml down -v
scripts.test:multisite: docker compose -f ../docker-compose.multisite-e2e.yml down -v && docker compose -f ../docker-compose.multisite-e2e.yml up --build --abort-on-container-exit && docker compose -f ../docker-compose.multisite-e2e.yml down -v
scripts.test:all: npm run test:docker && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:multisite
